text:
sara: ran quantization bring-up for gpt-small-qa on dedicated infra, saw weird divergence between token-level metrics. BLEU/ROUGE up ~1.2pts, but BERTScore dropped 0.06. anyone seen this after int8?

mike: hmm could be tokenization mismatch or duplicate de-dup in runner. did the runner dedupe responses after sampling?

julia: we recently flipped a change in the eval runner: we account for unique generations for pass@k but still feed all samples into BERTScore. could cause count skew.

rahul: can you paste the runner snippet? i want to check how we aggregate.

sara: sure — here's the reduction logic we use now:

```python
# eval_runner.py extract
all_outputs = samples_by_prompt[prompt]  # list of str (could have dups)
if dedupe_for_passk:
    passk_candidates = list(set(all_outputs))
else:
    passk_candidates = all_outputs
# we compute pass@k on passk_candidates but compute bert on all_outputs
bert_preds = all_outputs
```

mike: oh yeah that's the bug. pass@k should use the same population as other metrics (or at least be explicit). using set() changes distribution and hurts BERTScore when duplicates removed.

julia: quick fix: make dedupe configurable per-metric and document it. also add an integ test where we create a synthetic prompt with repeated outputs and assert pass@k and bertscore behavior.

rahul: +1. also noticed our BLEU impl lowercases and strips punctuation while BERTScore gets raw tokens. normalization mismatch could explain the BLEU/ROUGE bump too. we should canonicalize inputs before metric compute.

sara: planned patch:
1) revert implicit dedupe for pass@k; add flag `dedupe_population` default False
2) add `normalize_text=True` for BLEU/ROUGE pipeline (lowercase, collapse spaces, strip trailing punctuation)
3) add unit test in tests/eval_metrics/test_population_handling.py with samples: ["Yes","Yes","yes!","No"]. expected: pass@2=1.0 (if dedupe False), bertscore computed on raw normalized strings.

mike: can the eval-bot re-run the quant job after fix? tagging @eval-bot for a smoke run. :party_parrot:

eval-bot: scheduled re-run of quant-eval job `qrun/gpt-small-qa/195678` — results will post here when complete.

julia: also add a CI gate: tests/eval_metrics/population_handling must pass before any merge to eng-ml. i can take the PR and add the test harness.

rahul: one more note: document behavior in metrics.md (eng-ml/docs) so data-science folks understand dedupe semantics. we had a support ticket where product expected dedupe for pass@k by default.

sara: thanks all — i'll open the PR with the three changes + changelog. will ping when eval-bot posts the re-run.

mike: nice, thanks.

eval-bot: re-run finished. summary: BLEU delta +1.1, ROUGE-L +0.9, BERTScore delta +0.02 after fixes. full artifact: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/qruns/195678/results.html

sara: looks much closer now. marking root-cause as "eval_runner population mismatch + normalization" for the onboarding doc. closing thread soon. :white_check_mark:
